english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when a supply or resource has been used up completely.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose expression when something is used up completely.
Use 用晒 when “waste” means using something up completely.

examples.english: During typhoons, we quickly exhaust our emergency water supply.
examples.traditional: 打風嗰幾日，我哋好快就用晒啲應急食水。
examples.jyutping: daa2 fung1 go2 gei2 jat6 ngo5 dei6 hou2 faai3 zau6 jung6 saai3 di1 jing3 gap1 sik6 seoi2

examples.english: We consume a whole roll of toilet paper in a day.
examples.traditional: 我哋一日用晒一卷廁紙。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 jat6 jung6 saai3 jat1 gyun2 ci3 zi2

examples.english: The ink is all used up, so don't waste any more.
examples.traditional: 啲墨水已經用晒喇，唔好再浪費。
examples.jyutping: di1 mak6 seoi2 ji5 ging1 jung6 saai3 laa3 m4 hou2 zoi3 long6 fai3
